    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * n):
        row = []
        br, ir = divmod(r, n)
        sr = ir if br == 1 else n - 1 - ir
        for c in range(3 * m):
            bc, ic = divmod(c, m)
            sc = ic if bc == 1 else m - 1 - ic
            row.append(grid[sr][sc])
        out.append(row)
    return out
